name: DeepSeek Harness Observability
description: OpenTelemetry-based observability for dsh (DeepSeek Harness) with Ant AI Agent semantic conventions. Traces, metrics, and events are captured directly from the dsh session firehose.

enableTelemetry.label: Enable Telemetry (Master Switch)
enableTelemetry.help: Must be enabled for any telemetry data collection. Env: DSH_OBSERV_ENABLED=1

collectionMode.label: Collection Mode
collectionMode.help: full records configured content; privacy redacts content-bearing telemetry. Env: DSH_OBSERV_COLLECTION_MODE

debug.label: Debug Logging
debug.help: Enable verbose plugin diagnostic logging. Does not enable transcript capture or offline replay. Env: DSH_OBSERV_DEBUG

otelExporter.label: OTel Exporter Configuration
otelExporter.help: Base OTLP endpoint, protocol, and headers.

enableTelemetry.description: Enable telemetry collection (master switch). Env: DSH_OBSERV_ENABLED

collectionMode.description: Collection mode. 'privacy' forces content-bearing payloads to [REDACTED]. Env: DSH_OBSERV_COLLECTION_MODE

debug.description: Enable verbose plugin diagnostic logging. Env: DSH_OBSERV_DEBUG

dynamicUsername.description: Resolve ant.username from AIVISION_ANT_USERNAME whenever telemetry is recorded

dynamicUid.description: Resolve ant.uid from AIVISION_ANT_UID whenever telemetry is recorded

configFile.description: Explicit path to a JSON config file (pi/opencode schema). Default resolution: DSH_OBSERV_CONFIG → ~/.config/dsh/aivision.config.json → bundled configs/aivision.config.json

endpoint.description: Base OTLP endpoint URL. Env: DSH_OBSERV_OTLP_ENDPOINT or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT

attributes.description: Common signal attributes, including ant.username and ant.uid

resourceAttributes.description: Resource attribute overrides. ant.agent.type and ant.agent.product are fixed to dsh / DeepSeekHarness
